item.title: Patch now: Critical authentication vulnerability in Canonical LXD and MicroCloud
item.description:
Canonical LXD and MicroCloud: fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Canonical LXD and MicroCloud. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available
